source_visual_observations: Right triangle ABC with A90°, B50°, altitude AD to BC, and AE bisecting DAC. The 90° label at A has an arc; D retains its square.
audit.independent_solution: ABC is right-angled at A and B=50°, so C=40°. In right triangle ADC, DAC=50°. AE bisects DAC, hence DAE=25°, choice D.
